explanation: They carved them from basalt boulders about 3,000 years ago, and some stand taller than an adult. Many scholars think each portrays a particular ruler.

claims.text: The Olmecs carved colossal stone heads in the Gulf Coast lowlands of Mexico.
The Maya, Aztecs and Toltecs did not carve the Olmec colossal heads.
The Olmec colossal heads were carved from basalt boulders about 3,000 years ago.
Some Olmec colossal heads are taller than an adult person.
Many scholars think each colossal head portrays an individual ruler.
